parameters.jsCode:
const rawXml = $json.data || $json.body || JSON.stringify($json);
const match = rawXml.match(/<int>(\d+)<\/int>/) || rawXml.match(/<i4>(\d+)<\/i4>/);
const uid = match ? parseInt(match[1], 10) : null;

const payload = $('Validar Payload').first().json;

if (!uid) {
  return [{
    json: {
      authenticated: false,
      error: 'No se pudo autenticar contra Odoo dev.',
      ...payload
    }
  }];
}

const searchField = payload.partner_vat ? 'vat' : 'name';
const searchValue = payload.partner_vat || payload.partner_name;

const searchPartnerXml = `<?xml version="1.0"?>
<methodCall>
  <methodName>execute_kw</methodName>
  <params>
    <param><value><string>${payload.odoo_db}</string></value></param>
    <param><value><int>${uid}</int></value></param>
    <param><value><string>${payload.odoo_password}</string></value></param>
    <param><value><string>res.partner</string></value></param>
    <param><value><string>search_read</string></value></param>
    <param>
      <value>
        <array>
          <data>
            <value>
              <array>
                <data>
                  <value>
                    <array>
                      <data>
                        <value><string>${searchField}</string></value>
                        <value><string>=</string></value>
                        <value><string>${searchValue}</string></value>
                      </data>
                    </array>
                  </value>
                </data>
              </array>
            </value>
          </data>
        </array>
      </value>
    </param>
    <param>
      <value>
        <struct>
          <member>
            <name>fields</name>
            <value><array><data><value><string>id</string></value><value><string>name</string></value></data></array></value>
          </member>
          <member>
            <name>limit</name>
            <value><int>1</int></value>
          </member>
          <member>
            <name>order</name>
            <value><string>supplier_rank desc</string></value>
          </member>
        </struct>
      </value>
    </param>
  </params>
</methodCall>`;

const pCodesXml = (payload.product_codes || []).map(c => `<value><string>${c}</string></value>`).join('');
const searchProductsXml = `<?xml version="1.0"?>
<methodCall>
  <methodName>execute_kw</methodName>
  <params>
    <param><value><string>${payload.odoo_db}</string></value></param>
    <param><value><int>${uid}</int></value></param>
    <param><value><string>${payload.odoo_password}</string></value></param>
    <param><value><string>product.product</string></value></param>
    <param><value><string>search_read</string></value></param>
    <param>
      <value>
        <array>
          <data>
            <value>
              <array>
                <data>
                  <value>
                    <array>
                      <data>
                        <value><string>default_code</string></value>
                        <value><string>in</string></value>
                        <value><array><data>${pCodesXml}</data></array></value>
                      </data>
                    </array>
                  </value>
                </data>
              </array>
            </value>
          </data>
        </array>
      </value>
    </param>
    <param>
      <value>
        <struct>
          <member>
            <name>fields</name>
            <value><array><data><value><string>id</string></value><value><string>name</string></value><value><string>default_code</string></value><value><string>barcode</string></value><value><string>list_price</string></value></data></array></value>
          </member>
        </struct>
      </value>
    </param>
  </params>
</methodCall>`;

return [{
  json: {
    authenticated: true,
    odoo_uid: uid,
    search_partner_xml: searchPartnerXml,
    search_products_xml: searchProductsXml,
    ...payload
  }
}];

const partnerRawXml = $('Buscar Partner Odoo').first().json.data || JSON.stringify($('Buscar Partner Odoo').first().json);
const productsRawXml = $('Buscar Productos Odoo').first().json.data || JSON.stringify($('Buscar Productos Odoo').first().json);
const context = $('Parse Auth Response').first().json;

const pIdMatch = partnerRawXml.match(/<name>id<\/name>\s*<value>(?:<int>|<i4>)(\d+)(?:<\/int>|<\/i4>)<\/value>/);
const pNameMatch = partnerRawXml.match(/<name>name<\/name>\s*<value><string>([^<]+)<\/string><\/value>/);
const partnerFound = !!pIdMatch;
const partnerId = partnerFound ? parseInt(pIdMatch[1], 10) : null;
const partnerFoundName = pNameMatch ? pNameMatch[1] : (context.partner_name || context.partner_vat || 'Proveedor desconocido');

const foundProdIds = [];
const prodIdRegex = /<name>id<\/name>\s*<value>(?:<int>|<i4>)(\d+)(?:<\/int>|<\/i4>)<\/value>/g;
let match;
while ((match = prodIdRegex.exec(productsRawXml)) !== null) {
  foundProdIds.push(parseInt(match[1], 10));
}

const prodIdsXml = foundProdIds.map(id => `<value><int>${id}</int></value>`).join('');
const preloadLotsXml = `<?xml version="1.0"?>
<methodCall>
  <methodName>execute_kw</methodName>
  <params>
    <param><value><string>${context.odoo_db}</string></value></param>
    <param><value><int>${context.odoo_uid}</int></value></param>
    <param><value><string>${context.odoo_password}</string></value></param>
    <param><value><string>stock.lot</string></value></param>
    <param><value><string>search_read</string></value></param>
    <param>
      <value>
        <array>
          <data>
            <value>
              <array>
                <data>
                  <value>
                    <array>
                      <data>
                        <value><string>product_id</string></value>
                        <value><string>in</string></value>
                        <value><array><data>${prodIdsXml}</data></array></value>
                      </data>
                    </array>
                  </value>
                </data>
              </array>
            </value>
          </data>
        </array>
      </value>
    </param>
    <param>
      <value>
        <struct>
          <member>
            <name>fields</name>
            <value><array><data><value><string>id</string></value><value><string>name</string></value><value><string>product_id</string></value><value><string>expiration_date</string></value></data></array></value>
          </member>
        </struct>
      </value>
    </param>
  </params>
</methodCall>`;

const partnerRef = context.partner_ref || '';
let checkDuplicateXml = '';
if (partnerFound) {
checkDuplicateXml = `<?xml version="1.0"?>
<methodCall>
  <methodName>execute_kw</methodName>
  <params>
    <param><value><string>${context.odoo_db}</string></value></param>
    <param><value><int>${context.odoo_uid}</int></value></param>
    <param><value><string>${context.odoo_password}</string></value></param>
    <param><value><string>purchase.order</string></value></param>
    <param><value><string>search_read</string></value></param>
    <param>
      <value>
        <array>
          <data>
            <value>
              <array>
                <data>
                  <value>
                    <array>
                      <data>
                        <value><string>partner_id</string></value>
                        <value><string>=</string></value>
                        <value><int>${partnerId}</int></value>
                      </data>
                    </array>
                  </value>
                  <value>
                    <array>
                      <data>
                        <value><string>partner_ref</string></value>
                        <value><string>=</string></value>
                        <value><string>${partnerRef}</string></value>
                      </data>
                    </array>
                  </value>
                </data>
              </array>
            </value>
          </data>
        </array>
      </value>
    </param>
    <param>
      <value>
        <struct>
          <member>
            <name>fields</name>
            <value><array><data><value><string>id</string></value><value><string>name</string></value><value><string>state</string></value><value><string>amount_total</string></value></data></array></value>
          </member>
          <member>
            <name>limit</name>
            <value><int>1</int></value>
          </member>
        </struct>
      </value>
    </param>
  </params>
</methodCall>`;

}

return [{
  json: {
    ...context,
    partner_found: partnerFound,
    partner_id: partnerId,
    partner_display_name: partnerFoundName,
    preload_lots_xml: preloadLotsXml,
    check_duplicate_xml: checkDuplicateXml
  }
}];
